case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH,

Thank you for your quote. We have read your remarks on the cost indices carefully.

Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We value our long cooperation and are confident we will find a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your response; our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. As to the quality record data you cited, that does not change our position. We have reviewed the quality data you provided, but given the current cost environment, our initial offer was already calculated tightly. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

To accommodate your preference for a longer term, we can offer €4.90 per unit for a 24-month contract with 45 days net payment terms as an alternative.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

We appreciate your revised offer and your commitment to our long-standing cooperation. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your commitment to our long-standing cooperation. It is always a pleasure working with you, and we value our shared history.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). We kindly ask you to decide soon, as this offer stays valid for 7 days. Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

As an alternative, as our pricing leaves little room for further adjustments, we can offer €4.91 per unit for a 24-month contract with 60 days net payment terms. Specifically, we can provide a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This represents our best effort to accommodate your request while maintaining our high service standards.
